# ⚓ The Shattered Coast — Day 1

The morning sun breaks through a bank of grey fog, painting the world in pale gold and sea-salt haze. You wake to the sound of waves crashing against rock and the distant cry of gulls.

🏚️ **Driftwood Cove**

Bramble, you're the first to stir — old habits from sleeping with one eye open in Waterdeep's alleys. You're lying on a bedroll inside a half-collapsed fisherman's shack, its roof open to the sky on one side. The smell of brine and rotting kelp fills your nostrils.

Across the room, **Thorin Ironforge** sits with his back against the wall, battleaxe laid across his knees — either he never slept, or he's been up since before dawn. The iron rings in his beard glint in the early light. He gives you a curt nod.

*"Morning, halfling."* His voice is gravel. *"Storm's passed. We should move."*

You both came ashore here two days ago after the merchant vessel *Lucky Minnow* broke apart on the reef in a squall. You're the only two survivors who washed up on this stretch of coast. Your supplies are whatever you could salvage from the wreck and what was already on your backs.

🗺️ **What You Can See:**

From the shack's doorway, the Shattered Coast spreads before you:

- **⬅️ WEST — The Cliffs:** A line of jagged chalk cliffs runs along the coast, riddled with sea caves visible at low tide. Something metallic glints partway up the cliff face. Could be wreckage... or something else.

- **⬆️ NORTH — The Coastal Road:** A crumbling dirt path winds up from the beach through scrubby grassland. A weathered signpost stands at the trailhead, though you can't read it from here. Roads lead to towns. Towns mean supplies. 🛤️

- **➡️ EAST — The Tidepools & Wreckage:** Scattered debris from the *Lucky Minnow* lies among the rocks and tidepools. The tide is low now — good time to scavenge, but it won't last. ⏳

- **⬇️ SOUTH — Open Sea:** Grey water stretching to the horizon. Nothing but waves and weather out there.

---

**Party Status:**
| Character | HP | AC | Notable |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🗡️ Bramble Thornfoot | 9/9 | 14 | 15 gp, 20 arrows |
| 🪓 Thorin Ironforge | 13/13 | 18 | 10 gp |

Thorin stands, chain mail clinking, and squints toward the cliffs. *"Could be useful salvage in those caves before the tide turns. Or we find that road and get our bearings."* He shrugs. *"Your call, Bramble. You're the one with the clever eyes."* 👀

**What do you do?** 🎲
